scopeApproval: Owner instruction FULL AUTOPILOT E0/E1 steps01-11; no E2-E4 or Production authorization
surfaceUniverse: Tracked App Router route.ts files in apps/sg-runtime, apps/dashboard-preview, apps/srm at sourceSha; plus explicit non-route and external dependency boundaries. Does not claim every line or external endpoint audited.

regressionScenarios.acceptance: Forged x-clerk headers/body/cookie, absent/expired/wrong issuer/token/session; no private read or effect.
Disabled account, revoked session/membership/grant/product; queued and cached operations must re-evaluate before use.
Health/login/logout and safe public advisory work without leaking configuration, tokens, private data or raw exceptions.
A cannot read/update/delete/export B; owner columns and cross-organization foreign keys cannot be changed to escape RLS.
Users U/V in the same organization share org data but not personal lists/preferences; account-private ownership is independent.
Direct route factory, alternative API, dashboard, worker/CLI, KYS proxy and export enforce equivalent permission/resource/effect checks.
Intent durable before effect; effect/outcome atomic where local; failure evidence durable; ordinary runtime cannot rewrite or erase audit/policy.
Read/search/select/edit and cost weighting preserve IDs, mappings, numeric semantics and organizational ownership.
Current/verification/prepared/cadence/unit/time-series values and UI retained; shared forecast content is not relabeled tenant-private.
Service grant and initiator, bound operation/resource/environment/idempotency; revocation before execution/read; retries do not duplicate paid effects.
Shared content keys vs private ordering metadata; scoped exports/temp files/signed URLs; denial cannot return a previously cached private result.
Public company knowledge separated from supplier interests, requester, export selection and PII; projection writes not falsely treated read-only.
Existing financial statements/XHTML/units/provenance/scanner/radar/excel regressions remain valid; no live vendor calls in replay.
Existing reusable srm-xray business module uses real protected read/projection in SRM and SG2; React18/Next14 and React19/Next16 UI builds separately verified.
Clean and populated schemas; owner vs ordinary role; additive migrations; previous artifact schema compatibility and executed recovery rehearsal.
Exact reviewed package/version/integrity; secret only in trusted install; candidate code receives no install token; non-main/fork refusal preserved.
Fresh exact source, deployed artifact/config/data verification, owner Environment review, actual business behavior and rollback; first deployment has no invented LKG.

   FROM srm.source_snapshots snapshot
